answerCheck.derivedAnswer: D. The limit of the average rate of change as the increment approaches 0.
answerCheck.reason: At x, the instantaneous rate is the limit of (f(x+h)-f(x))/h as h approaches 0, when that limit exists.
For x≠1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1. Consequently its limit as x approaches 1 is 1+1=2, despite the original expression being undefined at 1.
